name: sgs/pricing-table
title: SGS Pricing Table
description: Pricing plans displayed in responsive columns with features, CTAs, monthly/yearly toggle, and optional badges.

wrapper.label: Wrapper
wrapper._note: Mirrors sgs/container's wrapper/grid split. Typography (fontSize/lineHeight) migrated OFF this element's WP-native support onto the `title` element's own titleFontSize*/titleLineHeight* attrs (D971/D972 full-replacement track) — the native support always rendered onto `.sgs-pricing-table__name` via `selectors.typography`, not the wrapper, so this was a mis-scoped mapping being corrected, not a capability removed. The remaining text-cluster members (letterSpacing/textTransform/textAlign/fontFamily) are honest gaps. The 12 ARRANGEMENT members also apply here (layer OUTER) and are resolved by the sibling `inner` element.

inner.label: Inner (grid / flex layout)
inner._note: Composite-mirror grid capability (shared SGS_Container_Wrapper, kind='layout'). Maps explicitly — no `prefix` declared (ROLLOUT REQUIREMENT 1). This block has NO `alignItems` attribute — an honest gap.

title.label: Plan name
title._note: Rendered once per plan into `.sgs-pricing-table__name` (block.json `selectors.typography` used to also target the back-compat `.sgs-pricing-table__title` alias, before the native support this element hosted was retired). `prefix: title` added 2026-09-05 (D971/D972 full-replacement track) so titleFontSize/titleFontSizeUnit/titleFontWeight/titleFontStyle/titleLineHeight/titleLineHeightUnit resolve via the standard {prefix}{Suffix} convention with no explicit attrMap entry needed (mirrors sgs/counter's `label` element) — this element previously had no font-size/weight control at all; that gap is now closed. `attrMap.tag` stays explicit — `headingLevel` sets the rendered tag on this element (render.php:379/381) and does not follow the typography-suffix convention. titleColourGradient (cluster A Task 2) is the text-colour gradient sibling to titleColour — background-clip:text mechanism, same recipe as priceColour/priceColourGradient; the 'fill' cluster was added solely to place this member. The rendered declaration paints onto a comma-joined selector pair (`.sgs-pricing-table__name,.sgs-pricing-table__title`) — see render.php's `$title_sel`. 2026-09-05: `states.hover.css:color`->titleColourHover declared explicitly (render.php:610-616 -- `sgs_emit_state_colour_css( $title_sel, array(), array( 'color:…' ) )`, whose third argument is the HOVER decl list, emitted via `sgs_hover_state_rules()` on `:hover, :focus-visible`, helpers-tokens.php:1351-1363). Without it titleColourHover derived to state=NULL and collided with ctaColourHover/popularBadgeColourHover on the (color, element=NULL, state=NULL) slot.

price.label: Price
price._note: Only colour is block-level and independently controlled for `.sgs-pricing-table__price` — no priceFontSize/Weight exists, an honest gap. priceColourGradient (D636 Task 1b) is the text-colour gradient sibling to priceColour — background-clip:text mechanism; the 'fill' cluster was added solely to place this member. `states.hover.attrMap` added 2026-09-03 — without it priceColourHover cross-attributed to css_element='toggle-label' via the CSS-scan signal (a genuine classifier confusion, same class as the option-picker pillBgColour bug fixed earlier this session; explicit attrMap is always authoritative over the derived signal).

feature.label: Feature list item
feature._note: Only colour is block-level and independently controlled for `.sgs-pricing-table__feature` — no featureFontSize/Weight exists, an honest gap. featureColourGradient (cluster A Task 2) is the text-colour gradient sibling to featureColour — background-clip:text mechanism, same recipe as priceColour/priceColourGradient; the 'fill' cluster was added solely to place this member. 2026-09-05: `states.hover.css:color`->featureColourHover declared explicitly (render.php:621-626 -- `sgs_emit_state_colour_css()` on `$root_sel . ' .sgs-pricing-table__feature'`, the same selector this element's base attrMap paints, third argument = hover decls). Without it featureColour and featureColourHover both derived to (color, feature, state=NULL) and collided on one routing slot.

cta.label: CTA button
cta._note: `ctaStyle` (accent/outline/etc. preset) is a variant/behaviour field, not an independent style control, so it is not mapped. No independent CTA font-size/border/padding attrs exist — honest gaps. ctaColourGradient (2026-09-04, D956) is the text-colour gradient sibling to ctaColour, safe unconditionally since ctaBackground already paints on a separate ::after layer (render.php sgs_block_background_layer_css()). ctaBackgroundGradient (2026-09-04) is the fill-colour gradient sibling to ctaBackground -- non-empty wins, resolved via sgs_background_paint_decl() on that same ::after layer. 2026-09-05: `states.hover.css:color`->ctaColourHover declared explicitly (render.php:585-590 -- `sgs_emit_state_colour_css( $pt_cta_sel, array(), array( 'color:…' ) )`, `$pt_cta_sel` at render.php:563 being the same `.sgs-pricing-table__cta` selector this element's base attrMap paints). Without it ctaColourHover derived to state=NULL and collided with titleColourHover/popularBadgeColourHover on the (color, element=NULL, state=NULL) slot. `ctaBackgroundHover` is NOT declared here -- it was not among the gate's findings and its emission was not audited in this pass.

badge.label: Popular badge
badge._note: `popularBadgeText` (the badge copy) is a content field, not a style control — it correctly surfaces as an ORPHAN under this element's `popularBadge` prefix, matching the FR-35-4 pattern (wired to a real attribute, invisible to cluster-coherence, no separate note needed to suppress it). popularBadgeColourGradient (2026-09-04, D936/D937) is the text-colour gradient sibling, safe unconditionally since popularBadgeBackground paints on the badge's own `::after` layer (render.php), not this selector. popularBadgeBackgroundGradient (2026-09-04) is the fill-colour gradient sibling to popularBadgeBackground -- non-empty wins, resolved via sgs_background_paint_decl() on that same ::after layer. 2026-09-05: `states.hover.css:color`->popularBadgeColourHover declared explicitly (render.php:489-495 -- `sgs_emit_state_colour_css( $pt_badge_sel, array(), array( 'color:…' ) )`, `$pt_badge_sel` at render.php:472 being the same `.sgs-pricing-table__badge` selector this element's base attrMap paints). This resolves BOTH gate findings for the attribute: the (color, element=NULL, state=NULL) three-way collision with titleColourHover/ctaColourHover, and the UNDECLARED sub-element paint -- the paint is on the badge element itself, not a sub-element, so the correct fix is this declaration rather than a new element key. `popularBadgeBackgroundHover` is NOT declared here -- it was not among the gate's findings and its emission was not audited in this pass.

ribbon.label: Per-plan ribbon
ribbon._note: `ribbonColour`/`ribbonText` vary PER PLAN INSTANCE inside the `plans` repeater array (not flat block attributes), so they cannot resolve via the block-attribute convention this manifest checks. Rendered per-instance as a `--sgs-pt-ribbon-bg` CSS custom-property VALUE (no-inline contract compliant), consumed by a single static scoped rule.

plan-card.label: Plan card (repeater item)
plan-card._note: name/description/features/ctaText/ctaUrl/iconName/highlighted/period/savingsBadgeText are per-plan CONTENT fields inside the `plans` array, not independent style controls — mirrors sgs/card-grid's card-tile/card-badge documentation pattern for `arrayContentLift` blocks.

behaviour.label: Toggle + animation behaviour
behaviour._note: billingToggle/toggleStyle/billingToggleMonthlyLabel/billingToggleYearlyLabel (toggle configuration) are content/behaviour fields, not style-cluster members. sgsAnimation/sgsAnimationDuration/sgsAnimationEasing (scroll-reveal preset) now resolve via the FR-35-6 `animation` cluster (anim:preset/anim:duration/anim:easing) — this block has no staggerDelay attribute, so anim:stagger is an honest gap; anim:parallax/anim:trigger are also honest gaps (no bgParallax/scroll-trigger attrs on this block).

_selectorsNote: S1 fix (2026-09-02, uniformity sweep, inspector-scan rule 33): selectors.typography retargeted from '.sgs-pricing-table__title' (never emitted by any rendered markup) to '.sgs-pricing-table__name' (render.php:364, the block's real per-plan title element). Removed 2026-09-05 (D971/D972) — the WP-native typography support this selector redirected is gone; the `title` element now owns titleFontSize*/titleLineHeight* as block-private attrs rendered via sgs_typography_css_rule(), which targets its own selector directly (render.php's `$title_sel`) and needs no Block Selectors API redirection.

ctaColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the CTA text with a background-clip:text mechanism instead of a flat colour (D956 text-colour gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over ctaColour. Safe unconditionally -- ctaBackground already paints on a separate ::after layer (sgs_block_background_layer_css()).

ctaBackgroundGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the CTA's background-fill instead of a flat colour, on the same `::after` layer as ctaBackground (D956-shape rollout). Non-empty wins over ctaBackground. Safe unconditionally -- the layer already sits behind ctaColour/ctaColourGradient's text paint, never on the same selector.

popularBadgeColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the popular badge's text with a background-clip:text mechanism instead of a flat colour (D936/D937 text-colour gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over popularBadgeColour. Safe unconditionally -- popularBadgeBackground already paints on the badge's own ::after layer.

popularBadgeBackgroundGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the popular badge's background-fill instead of a flat colour, on the badge's own `::after` layer (D956-shape rollout). Non-empty wins over popularBadgeBackground. Safe unconditionally -- the layer already sits behind popularBadgeColour/popularBadgeColourGradient's text paint, never on the same selector.

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColour.
